sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at already messing up on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: You've got to be kidding me. Today of all days?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and exasperated, with a rising panic that her already bad start to the term is being unfairly made worse.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, okay. Don't panic. Fast walk, transfer, survive.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is tense and flustered but trying to rally herself with determined, self-directed optimism, using a brisk pep talk to keep panic at bay.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Made it! Barely! I am never trusting that line again.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless relief and triumphant frustration at having arrived just in time, still keyed up from the morning’s chaos but trying to shake it off with upbeat determination.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Year one, class three... end of the hall, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s still flustered and hurried, but trying to stay upbeat and focused as she confirms the classroom location and pushes herself to keep moving.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and breathless from rushing in late, but still trying to stay upbeat and make a cheerful first impression despite the embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a jolt of embarrassed panic that she instantly masks with playful, self-aware humor, trying to recover her confidence and keep the moment light.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and flustered, but trying to cover her embarrassment with self-deprecating humor and a forced, upbeat attitude.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: What kind of map prints north in six-point font?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and embarrassed, but mostly venting incredulous frustration at the absurd mistake while trying to keep her spirits up with humor.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... please let the teacher be nice.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and anxious after a string of humiliating mistakes, but still pushing herself forward with hopeful, pleading determination that the teacher will be forgiving.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.text: Please tell me you're also in 1-3 and not judging me too hard.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed from her string of mishaps, but is trying to recover with upbeat, self-deprecating humor and a hopeful need for reassurance.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Then lead the way, hero. I'll owe you my life for at least one lunch break.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and amused, with her embarrassment easing into playful gratitude and a quick, friendly trust in Miyu.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is still flustered and embarrassed from the morning’s chaos, but trying to recover with upbeat, polite confidence and a hopeful desire to make a good first impression.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish and embarrassed, but also relieved enough to joke lightly because the teacher’s deadpan confirmation makes her blunder feel hilariously undeniable rather than disastrous.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you! I swear this is not my usual brand.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, trying to laugh off the chaos and reassure everyone that this flustered first-day disaster is not who she normally is.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. New term status: messy start, but not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish but relieved, trying to laugh off the chaos and regain confidence now that the worst of the morning is over.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile
